headline: Resolution co-naming Illinois Street as “Veterans and First Responders Way” and a resolution supporting the Community Development Block Grant Program.
summary: The council will consider a peddler license for MC Varieties, five board appointments, and two resolutions. It will also review department financial reports for September 2026.
items: Reappointment of Alberto Cardona of Providence to the Juvenile Hearing Board, term expiring October 1, 2029
Appointment of Jessica Crespo of Providence to the Juvenile Hearing Board, term expiring October 1, 2029
Appointment of Isabella Ribeiro of Central Falls to the Tree Advisory Board, term expiring October 1, 2029
Appointment of Lorraine Savard of Central Falls to the Tree Advisory Board, term expiring October 1, 2029
Appointment of Luis Rivera of Central Falls to the Tree Advisory Board, term expiring October 1, 2029
Department financial reports for September 2026: City Clerk, Fire Department, and Department of Code Enforcement and Code
New peddler license for Michael Calderon, DBA MC Varieties, 26 Joslin Street, Providence, RI 02909, heard by the City Council sitting as Board of License Commissioners
Resolution supporting the Local Community Development Block Grant Program
Resolution co-naming Illinois Street as “Veterans and First Responders Way”
location: City Council Meeting, 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863
